errors.description: The frame is not valid JSON.
The frame is JSON but not a valid JSON-RPC 2.0 request (batches are not supported).
No handler is registered for the method.
The params do not match the method's schema.
errors.user: That input is not valid. Check it and try again.

errors.description: An unexpected failure inside hx. Infrastructure failure, not a tool outcome.
A settings file or the plugin settings failed schema validation. data.errors lists file, key, expected and found for each problem.
errors.user: A settings file could not be read, so nothing was changed; the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: The permission policy blocked a tool call. A policy decision is surfaced to the model as a tool error, and to RPC callers with this code.
The session's mode can no longer change: the first prompt has been submitted and the system prompt is frozen for prompt caching.
The session ledger failed verification. It is never repaired silently. `data.broken_at_seq` names the first bad event when known.
The ledger refused an event that contraprova's task projection does not allow. The event was not written.
The ledger could not be opened or written (I/O error, lock timeout).
The session reached its cost cap. New turns are blocked until the cap is raised.
The hx binary is missing, could not be started, or kept crashing and the plugin stopped restarting it. A client-side failure: hx itself never sends it.
An hx call did not answer within the plugin's per-call timeout. The plugin sent $/cancelRequest first; data.cancelled says whether hx answered it.
The price catalogue could not be fetched, or the cached models-dev.json is not a valid catalogue. The previous file is left as it was.
`prices.refresh` was called while the plugin's `prices.refresh_enabled` setting is false.
The request was cancelled with $/cancelRequest before it changed anything.
Too many requests are queued; retry later.
A request frame exceeded the maximum size and was dropped.
At least one edit failed validation. Nothing was written. data.failures lists each failed edit with the closest match and its line numbers.
An edit targets a path outside the allowed globs. Checked before journaling. data.paths lists the paths.
An edit targets a protected path. Checked before journaling. data.paths lists the paths.
The workspace root cannot be opened as a directory.
The transaction exceeds a size or count limit.
A touched file changed between validation and write. Nothing was written.
A file an edit expected by its hash (`expect_sha256`) is not as expected: it changed since the caller looked. `data.paths` lists them. Nothing was written.
Another transaction holds the workspace lock.
A write failed after the transaction started. The workspace was restored from the journal; data.restored is true.
No journal with that id exists in the journal directory.
The journal's manifest or data failed verification. Nothing was changed.
The journal is in use by a live transaction.
The journal is not in a state that allows this operation.
Restoring from the journal failed. The journal is kept; run txn.recover or retry txn.restore.
An unexpected I/O failure before any workspace write.
A parameter is out of range or malformed: empty pattern, zero budget, bad line range, bad glob.
The search pattern does not compile as a regular expression.
root is not an existing directory.
A path is absolute, contains .., or resolves through a symlink outside root.
A named file or directory does not exist under root.
lang was given explicitly and no grammar is registered for it.
`tree-sitter` could not produce a tree (parser setup failure or internal timeout).
The `git` CLI is missing, exited with an error or printed output that could not be parsed.
The deadline passed before the call finished.
An embedded data file (`redact.rules.json`, `never_pack.json`, `languages.json`) or a query does not load. Fails closed.
An unexpected operating-system error while reading under root.
The platform cannot enforce a requested sandbox dimension and the policy did not allow degrading it. Nothing ran. data.dimension and data.reason say which.
The OS refused while the sandbox was being built or applied, so the command did not run. data.step names the setup step.
A long-lived sandboxed child could not be started (`sandbox.spawn` only; `sandbox.run` reports the same condition as the exit kind `spawn_failed`).
No running sandbox child has that handle: it never existed, or sandbox.wait already returned its exit.
Too many sandbox children are running at once; wait for or kill one.

Mods cannot run here: the sandboxed worker needs a private channel and an enforcing sandbox, and this platform has none (Windows today). Nothing ran, and mods never fall back to running unsandboxed. data.reason says why.
A mod could not be loaded: unreadable or invalid files, a failed import, a `register` that threw or ran past its budget. The message names the plugin and the cause.
The plugin's hooks/hooks.json has no `modules` key, so there is nothing to run.
A mod with this name is already loaded in the session; unload it first.
No mod worker runs for this session: load a mod first.
The sandboxed worker exited, crashed or stopped answering. Its mods are gone; load them again. data.stderr holds the last of its error output.
The worker's runtime could not be driven to an answer (a stalled chain). The session's mods must be reloaded.
hx has no connection to the plugin to ask about a `$` call (a one-shot run, not `hx serve`).
The plugin did not answer a `$` call in time; the mod's promise rejects with this code.
A `$` call could not reach the plugin, or the plugin failed while performing it.
A `$` call that boopis does not provide yet (process, mcp, model, agent, tool, prompt, turn, settings, audio, telemetry). It is refused by name, never ignored.
The exec kernel exited, was killed (hard timeout, an unresponsive cancel, its lifetime limit) or lost its channel. Its variables are gone; the next exec call starts a fresh kernel.
A cell made more tool calls than the per-cell limit (`exec.max_calls_per_cell`).
The kernel is running a cell, or too many kernels are busy to start another.
A harness feature is not available yet (diagnostics, waiting on a form). The answer says so instead of inventing one.
`harness.sh` could not start the command (the program was not found or could not be executed).
A harness call had malformed arguments, or exec was called without a session or working directory.
Hermes is not installed, cannot be started, or its gateway cannot be reached. The host's own code; the plugin never sends it.
errors.user: boopis's engine is not answering. Choose Retry, or restart boopis; the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: The installed Hermes is older than `requires_hermes`, or its gateway speaks a protocol or code identity the host cannot use.
errors.user: boopis's engine is a version this app cannot use. Reinstall boopis to get a matching one; the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: boopis's engine refused or failed a call, and its own words are not boopis's. The UI shows the catalog sentence; the engine's raw reason goes to the log and to Settings, General, Diagnostics only (ADR-0031).
errors.user: boopis's engine could not do that. Try again; the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: An action that needs the user's consent (running an installer, changing Hermes's configuration) was requested without `consent: true`. Nothing ran.
errors.user: That change needs your go-ahead first. Review it, then confirm.

errors.description: A request on the host's local channel carried a wrong or missing token. Nothing was read.
A gateway frame is not a valid JSON-RPC 2.0 message or is larger than the cap. It was not forwarded.
errors.user: boopis dropped a message it could not read. Try again; the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: The connection id is not (or no longer) open.
errors.user: This window lost its connection. Reload the window.

errors.description: A request from Hermes needed an answer and no window is attached to give it, so the host declined it.
errors.user: A question came in while no window was open to answer it, so boopis declined it. Ask again with a window open.

errors.description: The operating system refused or failed an integration call (dialog, notification, opener).
errors.user: Your system refused to open that dialog, notification or link. Try again.

errors.description: A background task of the host ended without an answer: it panicked (a bug in boopis) or was cancelled while boopis closed. The raw text is in Settings, General, Diagnostics and the log; the step that failed saved nothing.
errors.user: Something went wrong inside boopis, and nothing was changed. Try again; if it happens again, the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: A failure in the UI that carries no code of the host's: a script error, or a call that was cut off. The UI shows the sentence and keeps the raw text for Settings, General, Diagnostics. The host never sends it.
errors.user: boopis could not do that. Try again; if it happens again, the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: No secret store is available: on Linux, no Secret Service (GNOME Keyring or `KWallet` 6) is running or unlocked. The message names the fix. Also sent when a plugin asks the host for a secret and the host's channel is not there.
errors.user: No keychain is running. Install and unlock GNOME Keyring, or turn on the Secret Service in KWallet 6, then try again.

errors.description: The secret store refused or failed an operation. No secret value is ever in the message.
errors.user: The keychain refused that. Unlock it and try again.

errors.description: No secret is stored under that service and account.
errors.user: No key is saved under that name.

errors.description: A secret reference is not `secret://<scope>/<name>`, or names a scope or name outside the allowed characters.
First-run setup found no usable Hermes. The step carries the documented install command; nothing was installed.
errors.user: boopis's engine is not installed on this computer. Run the command shown, then choose Check again.

errors.description: The app does not carry the plugin or the hx binary it should install (a development build, or a damaged bundle).
errors.user: This copy of boopis is missing parts it installs. Reinstall boopis.

errors.description: The plugin could not be copied into the profile's plugins directory, or Hermes did not enable it.
errors.user: boopis could not finish setting up its engine. Choose Retry; the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: The Claude subscription cannot be used here: the engine does not carry the Claude subscription plugin (boopis's own runtime does; a user's own engine may not), or the plugin serves none of the models the user's Claude Code serves. Nothing was changed.
errors.user: The Claude subscription is not available with this engine. Choose another model.

errors.description: boopis could not reach OpenAI's sign-in service for the ChatGPT sign-in (no network, TLS, a timeout). Nothing was stored.
errors.user: boopis could not reach OpenAI to sign you in. Check your internet connection or proxy, then try again. Nothing was saved.

errors.description: OpenAI's sign-in service is limiting requests (HTTP 429). A stored sign-in is kept; the user tries again in a minute.

errors.description: OpenAI's sign-in service answered that it offers no device-code sign-in for this client (HTTP 404).
errors.user: OpenAI does not offer this sign-in right now. Try again later, or choose another model.

errors.description: The ChatGPT sign-in or its renewal failed: an answer from OpenAI's sign-in service that boopis could not use. The message says which step; nothing was stored.
errors.user: The ChatGPT sign-in did not finish. Try again; nothing was saved.

errors.description: `hermes config set` refused or failed a change. data.key names the key; nothing after it was applied.
errors.user: boopis could not save a setting it needs. Choose Retry; the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: The user declined the Hermes configuration changes. Setup stops there and says what will not work.
errors.user: You declined the changes, so some features are off. Choose Review again to change your mind.

errors.description: An answer does not match the form that is open (a different form id, a value outside the schema, a missing field).
errors.user: That answer is for a question that is no longer open. Answer the one shown now.

errors.description: The setup progress file is unreadable or written by a newer version. It is kept as it was and setup starts again from the checks.
errors.user: boopis could not read its setup progress, so setup starts again.

errors.description: After setup, the plugin did not answer `describe` or reported a configuration problem. data.errors lists them.
errors.user: Setup finished, but boopis's engine did not confirm it. Choose Retry; the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: The app carries no engine runtime archive where its manifest says, or the archive cannot be opened. Nothing was installed.
errors.user: This copy of boopis is missing its engine. Reinstall boopis.

errors.description: `runtime.json` is missing a field, names a path outside the archive, or does not parse. Nothing was installed.
errors.user: This copy of boopis cannot read the description of its engine. Reinstall boopis.

errors.description: The engine runtime archive's SHA-256 is not the manifest's. Nothing was extracted.
errors.user: boopis's engine failed its integrity check, so nothing was installed. Reinstall boopis.

errors.description: The engine runtime archive has an entry it may not have (a device node, a FIFO, a setuid bit, a path outside its folder) or exceeds its size or entry count. Nothing was kept.
errors.user: boopis's engine files are damaged, so nothing was installed. Reinstall boopis.

errors.description: Unpacking the engine runtime failed (disk, permissions). The temporary folder was removed; setup resumes on the next call.
errors.user: boopis could not unpack its engine. Check that the disk has free space, then choose Retry; the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: A form's schema is not a flat MCP elicitation object with the supported field types. data.errors lists each problem.
The submitted values do not satisfy the form's schema. data.errors lists file, key, expected and found; secret values are never in them.
No form has that id (it never existed, or the plugin restarted).
The form is already submitted, cancelled or expired.
`wait=true` ran out of time before the form was answered. The form stays open and can still be answered.
A secret field was reported as provided but the host holds no secret at its reference.
The form asks for something not available yet (for example a picker the host does not serve, or wait=true inside a cell past its timeout).
Too many forms are open in this session; answer or cancel one first.
A connector with that name is already in Hermes. Nothing was changed.

errors.description: What would be installed is not what the form showed (the collection or the request changed). Nothing was installed; review again.

errors.description: Hermes refused or failed a connector call; the message names the call and Hermes's reason. Never carries a key.

errors.description: A bot's turn failed for another reason the engine gave. Its words are kept for Diagnostics.

errors.user: The install did not finish and nothing was kept. Try again; the details are in Settings, General, Diagnostics.

errors.description: The operation does not apply to this way (a key for a sign-in, a sign-out the host does not own), or the command is not built yet.

errors.user: The provider did not accept that key. Check it, or make a new one.
